about: Static props of the story prologue (docs/STORY.md, Prolog im Detail): 12 kit modules, 21 set pieces and the mothership exterior. Each gets one Gemini picture (tools/meshy/prop_pictures.py) and then one Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D run (smart-topology, target_polycount as listed, 2k PBR textures, origin at bottom, remove_lighting). Machines are never props: clamps, racks, cradles and stations are shown empty, the robots in them are the game's own models. size_m is [width, depth, height] in metres as placed in the level.
refs_note: Reference pictures are prologue scene pictures from the story board (docs/story/images), given to Gemini only for mood, materials and wear; the prompt forbids copying any robot from them.
style: Industrial machine part from the 1999 RTS Machines, remade: worn red paint (RGB 0.70/0.09/0.07) on dark grey steel (sRGB 60-80), chipped edges and some dust, no large rust patches; yellow-black hazard stripes where red meets black; panels as raised bolted plates with thick edges, seams as deep grooves, vents as recessed slats; ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body; black lamp discs with a yellow glass; screens dark and blank; chunky, low-detail silhouette that reads from 10 m; single object on pure white, 3/4 view from slightly above, even light, no text, no logos.
geometry: All detail is real geometry, never painted on: plates are raised separate pieces with thick edges and bolt heads, seams are deep grooves, vents and grilles are recessed slats you can see into, hoses stand off the surface. Only colour stripes and hazard stripes are paint. Round parts (drums, domes, discs, rings, columns) are truly round, smooth circles and not six- or eight-sided. Wear stays moderate: chipped paint on edges and some dust, no large rubbed-off or rusted patches.
kit_style_swap: ribbed corrugated hoses arching over and into the body
ribbed hoses only where the description names one, lying inside the tile's box and never on a walking surface or across an edge
kit_rule: This is a modular level-kit tile for a grid-based level: a SEAMLESS, straight-edged, box-shaped module. Its outer faces are flat and cut square at exact right angles, so copies of it fit edge to edge on a 1 metre grid without gaps; nothing sticks out past its rectangular box, every hose, pipe or cable stays inside that box, and the edges where it meets the next tile are clean, flat and straight (no bevelled or rounded outer silhouette, no broken or torn ends). Shown alone in a 3/4 view from slightly above so the top, the front and one side are visible.

props.name: kit_floor
props.description: Heavy deck floor plate of a spaceship maintenance hangar: a square, flat slab made of four bolted steel slabs with deep grooves between them, a recessed drain grille in one corner, a worn yellow-black edge stripe along one side.

props.name: kit_floor_grate
props.description: Open steel grating floor panel: a square, flat panel with a thick red frame, a square steel mesh you can see through, two cross beams underneath.

props.name: kit_wall
props.description: Tall bulkhead wall section, a thick upright rectangular slab twice as tall as it is wide: lower half red armour plates with thick bolted edges, upper half dark steel ribs, a horizontal ribbed hose running straight across the full width at about two thirds of the height, a recessed vent slat panel near the floor.

props.name: kit_wall_low
props.description: Short square bulkhead wall section for low rooms and ducts, a thick square slab: dark steel with one raised red plate, recessed slats, pipe brackets.

props.name: kit_pillar
props.description: Tall square structural pillar, eight times as tall as it is wide, with chamfered vertical edges: red lower third, a yellow-black hazard stripe band near the bottom, cable clamps, a black lamp disc halfway up.

props.name: kit_ceiling
props.description: Square ceiling panel, shown flipped upside down so its underside faces up toward the viewer: two heavy steel I-beams running across it, dark steel plates between them, a cable tray along one beam, one rectangular light fixture set into the plates.
props.note: The picture shows the underside facing up; the fit pass turns it over.

props.name: kit_door_frame
props.description: Heavy blast-door frame, a thick rectangular wall block with a large rectangular doorway cut through it: thick red armoured surround with yellow-black hazard stripes on the jambs, two hydraulic pistons on the sides, a warning lamp above, the opening empty (no door leaf), so you can see through it.

props.name: kit_door_leaf
props.description: One half of a sliding blast door, a tall thick rectangular slab standing upright: dark steel with raised bolted red plates, a diagonal yellow-black hazard stripe along its straight meeting edge, deep horizontal grooves.

props.name: kit_door_small
props.description: Small service door for maintenance robots set in a square wall block: square red frame, a single closed dark steel sliding leaf with a horizontal viewing slit, a small keypad panel beside it.

props.name: kit_duct
props.description: Straight square maintenance duct segment, a rectangular tunnel box open at both ends so you can look through it: riveted dark steel walls, internal ribs every metre, a ribbed hose running along the inside of the ceiling, a scuffed floor; both open ends cut flat and square.

props.name: kit_vent_cover
props.description: Wall vent cover, a flat rectangular panel standing upright: thick red frame with a heavy dark steel slat grille, one corner of the grille bent outward as if kicked open while the frame stays straight and square.

props.name: kit_grate_wall
props.description: Grate wall panel between corridors, a square flat panel standing upright: red frame, vertical steel bars with a diagonal cross brace, see-through.

props.name: clamp
props.description: Maintenance clamp gantry that holds a small spider robot in the air: two heavy red C-shaped arms hanging from a ceiling hoist block, hydraulic pistons, thick ribbed hoses and a cable bundle hanging down, a dark steel base ring on the floor below. Empty: no robot in it.

props.name: clamp_terminal
props.description: Small upright clamp status terminal: red steel case on a post, slanted blank black screen, three chunky buttons, a cable hose into the floor.

props.name: core
props.description: Giant ship computer core: a tall round column of stacked dark steel rings with dark blank slots, red armour bands with hazard stripes, many ribbed hoses arching from the top down into the floor, a heavy round base plinth. Truly round.

props.name: core_console
props.description: Operator console at the foot of a computer: a wide red steel desk with a slanted row of blank black screens, chunky switches, a probe socket port, hoses into the floor.

props.name: wall_screen
props.description: Wall-mounted monitor in a thick red bezel with bolts, a blank black screen, a cable hose from the bottom.

props.name: crate_small
props.description: Small cube cargo crate: dark steel box with red corner guards, raised bolted plates, a hazard stripe, lifting lugs on top.

props.name: crate_large
props.description: Large cargo crate used as cover: a long dark steel container, red reinforced corners, a hinged lid with clamps, recessed handles.

props.name: barrel
props.description: Coolant canister: a round red steel drum with two raised ribs, a yellow-black band, a valve and a short hose on top. Round.

props.name: weapon_rack
props.description: Wall weapon rack for robot arm weapons: a dark steel frame with red mounting clamps and a hazard-striped lower panel. All mounts empty: no weapons, no guns on it.

props.name: repair_station
props.description: Robot repair station: a round floor platform with a red hazard-striped ring, two articulated welding arms on a pillar, ribbed hoses, a hanging lamp, a blank status screen. Empty: no robot on it.

props.name: generator
props.description: Power generator block: a heavy dark steel housing with red end caps, cooling fins as recessed slats, two thick ribbed hoses, a warning lamp on top.

props.name: junction_box
props.description: Wall junction box: a red steel cabinet with a bolted door, cable hoses in and out, a lever on the side.

props.name: lamp_emergency
props.description: Wall emergency lamp: a black round disc lamp with a red glass under a steel wire cage, on a red steel wall bracket.

props.name: alarm_beacon
props.description: Rotating alarm beacon: a red steel base, a round amber glass dome in a protective cage. Round.

props.name: pa_speaker
props.description: Ship announcement loudspeaker: a square horn speaker in dark steel on a red bracket, a cable hose.

props.name: pipe_run
props.description: Wall pipe run: three thick straight parallel pipes and one ribbed corrugated hose on red brackets, a valve wheel.

props.name: cable_hang
props.description: A bundle of thick cables and ribbed hoses hanging down in loops from a ceiling bracket.

props.name: pod_cradle
props.description: Launch cradle for an escape pod: a heavy round red ring frame with four hydraulic clamp arms over an open round floor hatch, hazard stripes around the hatch, hoses. Empty: no pod in it.

props.name: bay_crane
props.description: Overhead gantry crane for a hangar, on a short section of its two rails: a long dark steel bridge beam with red end trucks on the rails, a hook block hanging on chains, warning lamps. Nothing on the hook.

props.name: debris_beam
props.description: A fallen, bent steel I-beam lying on its side, with torn red plating and dangling cables, as after an explosion.

props.name: debris_panel
props.description: A torn hull panel: a bent red armour plate ripped from a wall, jagged edges, broken bolts, one scorched side.

props.name: mothership
props.description: Huge blocky industrial seeding mothership, a starship that flies in space and never lands, seen whole as a scale model: a long tapered hull with a heavy engine block at the stern, a flat underside with rows of square pod hatches recessed into it, cranes and antenna masts on the back, worn red markings on dark grey, no glow, no flames, no engine fire. No wheels, no tracks, no legs, no landing gear: it is not a vehicle or a train.
props.note: Seen only from far in the Abwurf; size is a guess (about 1.2 km long), the board asset is a-mutterschiff.
